# Committee Roles 

These roles are held continuously from one AGM until the next.
The minimum tenure is therefore one year, except in exceptional circumstances.

We always welcome enthusiastic new recruites, and if you have some time to spare
we can work with you to help you find a way to contribute. 
However, these roles also benefit from some continuity, and are often held for 
a number of years at a time.

Where relevant, Swim England provides [guides](https://www.swimming.org/library/115) to each of these roles, which you can find on their website, and are linked in each role page that follows.
